text: poe_coverage_gap - Insufficient operationalisation of points of entry and control: functionality remains weak in Tshopo with only 6 of 19 (32%) activated and reporting completeness limited to 57%. Performance is further affected by screening refusals (2,100 people, 2.9%, in Nord-Kivu), assaults on providers and non-observance of the health protocol by some authorities at the Mukulia control point; a further 48 screening refusals (1.2%) were recorded, motivated by denial of the disease and fear of being admitted to a treatment centre.

text: ambulance_shortage - Insufficient referral capacity (2 ambulances out of service in Ituri, no ambulance in 7 Nord-Kivu health zones and no treatment centre in 4) and saturation of several treatment centres. In Haut-Uele no standard-compliant treatment centre exists across the 6 affected health zones, and mobility for burial teams is insufficient in the Wamba area.
